_comment: External dependency: the pi_agent_rust GitHub release this extension is built and tested against. `tag` is the SINGLE pinned value — bump only it to move the supported floor. The managed download (src/rust-install.ts) fetches this tag; the README 'Rust Pi (tested)' badge reads it; a user-supplied binary of a different version gets a one-time warning (src/extension.ts). Dependabot can't track GitHub releases natively — .github/workflows/upstream-currency.yml opens an issue when a newer release appears, using the `datasource`/`repo`/`tag` fields below.
_platformNote: LINUX GLIBC FLOOR. v0.8.0's Linux assets need GLIBC_2.28 (measured with objdump -T on the released pi-linux-arm64 and pi-linux-amd64 binaries, checksums verified against SHA256SUMS; the release notes state the same floor, which upstream adopted in v0.6.0). That runs on Debian 10+, Ubuntu 18.10+ and RHEL 8+. It was not always so: v0.3.0 needed 2.39 and v0.5.1 needed 2.43, which excluded nearly every shipping distro. The handling for a floor that climbs again stays in place: the managed install probes the binary it just wrote, deletes it when it will not run, and names the glibc version the release needs (src/rust-install.ts); a configured-but-unrunnable rustBinaryPath is reported instead of silently substituted (src/rust-resolver.ts); and a readiness timeout carries the linker's own complaint (src/rust-process.ts). macOS and Windows are unaffected. Re-measure the floor when bumping this pin.
